title: Procedure that doubles a vector
statement: Write a DoubleElements procedure that takes an array of 3 integers by reference and its size, and doubles every element. Read 3 numbers, call the procedure and write the 3 resulting values, one per line.

assertions.name: DoubleElements
assertions.requirement: The statement asks for a procedure named DoubleElements with two parameters.
The statement asks you to solve it with an array.
